exact_statement: For every finite literal-leaf read-once Boolean formula at actual induced independent interior product laws, contract constant children and deterministic physical inputs. Let P be the final normalized product Fourier law, Q_flat its coefficient-rounded dyadic complete reference and Q_tree the composed complete gate dyadic references, both retaining P(empty). Let Delta=I-Var, R_F=sum_(|S|>=3)(|S|-2)P(S), omega_v the inherited nonnegative composition weights, and A_tree=sum_v omega_v(9Delta(g_v)-6R(g_v)). Then their corrected cross-entropies satisfy C_tree^+-C_flat^+=KL(P||Q_tree)-KL(P||Q_flat), with -(9Delta-6R_F)<=C_tree^+-C_flat^+<=A_tree<=9Delta, hence absolute signed conversion<=9Delta. Ordinary full cross-entropies obey the same difference after identical empty/bias terms are included. The references need not agree: AND3 at three biases1/3 has Q_flat({1})=104/12267 and Q_tree({1})=256/10521 in the AND2-of-AND2 decomposition. This bounds the expected signed conversion, not expected absolute log ratio, and permits neither a second KL rebate nor a new deficit bank. Universal dyadic-scale payment and full FEI remain unasserted.
